feature.label: Revision Graph for Git (SVN style)
feature.description: A TortoiseSVN-style revision graph for Git inside Eclipse. Commits, local and remote branches, tags, stashes and merges are drawn as connected, color-coded boxes by the same shared web renderer used by the VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains and Apache NetBeans hosts. Create a branch from any commit, merge or squash-merge branches, reword a message, undo a commit, check out, inspect changed files and diffs, stage and commit working-tree changes, apply stashes, and fetch/pull/push/sync from the toolbar.
